ops.title: Preserve release failure reasons during parent-to-child wait transfer
ops.description:
Owner: drive-lock coordinator (caller).
Next executable step: carry the claim identity into the release child so its failure resolves the durable claim atomically, or preserve a dropped-wait reason until the matching child wait is adopted.
Evidence: plugins/long-running/lib/drive/cli.py:1795-1812 first stores the parent's pid wait, then spawns and later adopts the child's pid wait. The child failure records dropped_waits keyed by its own pid (:1830). If it writes before adoption and watch.waits_lines runs first, watch.py:728 pops that reason while the parent's live wait still holds the job. After adoption, the next pass sees only the exited child and emits a generic FREE reason. The old spawn-and-save lock prevented the child's first write preceding installation of its wait.
Static review only; no tests run.

ops.text: A release failure before pid adoption retains its exact failure reason through an intervening watch pass.
The child's first writes and unrelated waits survive parent pid adoption.
